sections.heading: What is trending: “intel”
paragraphs: “intel” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for DE (snapshot taken 2026-11-15T09:24:25+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 500 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from HotHardware, PC Gamer, TechPowerUp. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “AMD Loses Desktop CPU Share for the First Time in Months, Intel Regains Ground” — TechPowerUp
“Intel takes unexpected bite out of AMD's desktop CPU market share” — PC Gamer
“AMD Snatches More Server CPU Share As Intel Rallies In Desktop Market” — HotHardware

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Sun, 15 Nov 2026 00:10:00 -0800. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-11-15T09:24:25+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-11-15T09:25:35+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
